final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), totals AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS all_college_average, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(record_count * 1.0 / total_count) AS average_share, AVG(record_count - all_college_average) AS average_excess FROM college_counts CROSS JOIN totals WHERE record_count > all_college_average
